fusions.name: Wanted Poster
fusions.desc: Pins a wanted poster to the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bounty Collected
fusions.desc: A finishing blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Hunting Blind
fusions.desc: Hides you behind a paper screen for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Closing Chapter
fusions.desc: Against enemies low on health, you deal 12% more damage.
